tools.name: find_restaurant
tools.description:
Look up a Toronto restaurant you already have a name for.

Returns candidates, each with name_match (exact | partial | fuzzy | none) and a place_id.
An exact match is the restaurant; otherwise check the address. Next: get_restaurant(place_id)
or get_menu(place_id).

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description:
Find restaurants around a location, with Google's filters plus a per-person budget.

Each result has a place_id, rating, price range, distance, whether it is open now and any
awards. `excluded` counts places dropped by the filters and why. Next: get_restaurant(place_id)
for hours, booking and orderi

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description:
One restaurant's full profile: weekly hours (and kitchen, brunch, happy-hour hours), price
per person, phone, website, how to book (booking platform link, the restaurant's own booking
page, or phone), ordering links (own storefront, delivery apps), amenities (reservable,
outdoor seating, vegetarian

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description:

printed. Menus that are only images or scanned PDFs come back as attached images for you
